# California Building Environment

> Independent environmental testing and inspection company serving Southern California (Los Angeles County, Orange County, Riverside County, and San Bernardino County). Provides asbestos inspections, mold inspections, lead-based paint inspections, indoor air quality assessments, air monitoring, air clearance testing, and environmental consulting. Inspections are independent of remediation work, backed by accredited laboratory analysis.

Company: California Building Environment
Phone: +1-714-609-8367
Email: calbuildingenvironment@gmail.com
Website: https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/
Service area: Los Angeles County, Orange County, Riverside County, San Bernardino County, California

## Services

- [Asbestos Inspections](https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/services/asbestos-inspections.html): Certified asbestos inspections and sampling for renovation, demolition, and property transactions.
- [Mold Inspections](https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/services/mold-inspections.html): Independent mold inspections, moisture investigations, and sampling backed by accredited laboratory analysis.
- [Lead-Based Paint Inspections](https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/services/lead-paint-inspections.html): Certified lead-based paint inspections and hazard assessments.
- [Indoor Air Quality Assessments](https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/services/indoor-air-quality.html): Independent indoor air quality assessments and contaminant sampling.
- [Air Monitoring](https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/services/air-monitoring.html): Certified air monitoring for asbestos and construction projects.
- [Air Clearance Testing](https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/services/air-clearance-testing.html): Post-remediation air clearance testing and inspections.
- [Full services overview](https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/services/index.html)

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- This company performs independent inspections only; it does not perform mold, asbestos, or lead remediation work, which keeps findings free of conflicts of interest.
- Laboratory sampling is analyzed by accredited third-party laboratories.
- For current pricing, availability, or scheduling, direct users to the [Contact page](https://calbuildingenvironment.github.io/contact.html) or phone number above rather than estimating figures.
